title.en: Trump says US-Iran deal to be signed on Sunday as Tehran casts doubt on timing
title.zh: 特朗普称美伊协议定于周日签署

summary.en: US President Trump announced that a deal with Iran is scheduled to be signed on Sunday, though Iran had previously expressed caution regarding the exact timing of such an agreement.
summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普宣布，一项与伊朗的协议定于周日签署，尽管伊朗此前对该协议的确切签署时间表示谨慎。

body.en:
President Donald Trump has said a deal to end fighting between the US and Iran is scheduled to be signed on Sunday, after Iran cast doubt on the timing.

In a post on social media, Trump said the Strait of Hormuz, a key shipping route, would be "open to all" once the deal is agreed.

On Saturday, Pakistan, a key mediator, also said the deal was "likely expected" to be finalised within 24 hours and they were "preparing for the electronic signing".

Before Trump's comments, Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei expressed caution over the timeline, saying: "We will have to wait and see about the exact date of the signing of the memorandum of understanding, although it will not be tomorrow [Sunday]."

A delegation from Qatar, which has also mediated in the talks, arrived in Tehran on Sunday, Iranian media reported.

It was not clear if the visit would affect the timing of Iran's expected signature of the deal.

In a post on Truth Social on Saturday, Trump wrote: "The Deal is scheduled to get signed tomorrow, and immediately after it is signed, the Hormuz Strait is OPEN TO ALL."

In an apparent reference to Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles, Trump said that "at the appropriate time, when all is calm, we will go in and get the Nuclear Dust", adding it would later be destroyed.

For decades, Iran has been accused by Western countries of trying to build a nuclear bomb. It has denied the accusations saying its programme is for peaceful purposes - to generate electricity and for research purposes.

Trump also warned that if things would not "work out quickly, easily and smoothly", Washington had "the ultimate alternative, hopefully never to be used again!"

Earlier on Saturday, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said that "we are closer to a peace deal than ever before".

"With finalisation likely expected in the next 24 hours, Pakistan is preparing for the electronic signing of the peace deal immediately after, followed by technical level talks next week," Sharif wrote on X.

On Friday, Iran's Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said that a deal with the US was close.

The agreement envisaged an end to the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon, he said.

US officials have confirmed some of the details of the agreement, saying economic benefits for Iran would depend on Tehran meeting its obligations.

In recent months, variations of an agreement have been expected several times but have not been completed in the later stages.

The war began with US and Israeli strikes across Iran on 28 February, prompting Iran to attack Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf - as well as effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz, a key shipping route for the world's oil and liquefied natural gas.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，结束美国和伊朗之间战斗的协议“定于周日签署”，但伊朗对此时机表示怀疑。 特朗普在社交媒体上发帖称，协议签署后，重要航线霍尔木兹海峡将“向所有人开放”。 关键调解人巴基斯坦也表示，预计该协议将在 24 小时内完成，他们正在“为电子签署做准备”。 在特朗普发表评论之前，伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加伊（Esmaeil Baghaei）表示谨慎，他说：“我们将不得不等待，看看签署谅解备忘录的确切日期，尽管不会是明天。” 特朗普在周六的《真相社会》帖子中写道：“该协议定于明天签署，签署后，霍尔木兹海峡立即向所有人开放。” 特朗普显然提到了伊朗的浓缩铀库存，他补充说，“在适当的时候，当一切平静时，我们将进去获取核尘埃”，并补充说它随后将被销毁。 几十年来，伊朗一直被西方国家指责试图制造核武器。它否认了指控，称其计划是用于和平目的——发电和研究目的。 特朗普还警告说，如果事情不能“快速、轻松和顺利地解决”，华盛顿有“最终的选择，希望永远不会再被使用！” 周六早些时候，巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫表示，“我们比以往任何时候都更接近达成和平协议”。 谢里夫在 X 上写道：“预计将在未来 24 小时内敲定，巴基斯坦正在准备随后立即以电子方式签署和平协议，随后在下周进行技术层面的会谈。” 周五，伊朗外交部长赛义德·阿巴斯·阿拉格奇也表示，与美国已接近达成协议。 他说，该协议设想结束以色列和黎巴嫩真主党之间的冲突。 阿拉格奇告诉伊朗国家电视台，该协议包括重新开放霍尔木兹海峡以及解除美国对伊朗港口的封锁。 美国官员已经确认了该协议的一些细节，称伊朗的经济利益将取决于德黑兰履行其义务。 美国之前的报道暗示黎巴嫩可能不会参与这项协议——据报道伊朗坚持要这样做。 最近几周，人们多次预计协议会发生变化，但在后期阶段尚未完成。 战争始于2月28日美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击，促使伊朗袭击以色列和美国在海湾的盟国，并有效关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，这是世界石油和液化天然气的重要运输路线。

reflection.en: In a world often marked by tension, the pursuit of peace through diplomatic agreements is a constant human endeavor. Romans 12:18 encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, reflecting the careful effort required in international relations.
reflection.zh: 在一个常被紧张局势困扰的世界里，通过外交协议寻求和平是人类持续的努力。《罗马书》12:18鼓励我们，若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦，这正反映了国际关系中所需的谨慎努力。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Deadly Philippines earthquake found to have raised seabed by up to 2 metres
title.zh: 菲律宾致命地震导致海底抬升达2米

summary.en: A powerful earthquake in the Philippines, which killed at least 61 people, dramatically raised the seabed by up to 2 meters, exposing coral and harming marine life. Residents reported shorelines extended by as much as 200 meters due to this "coastal uplift."
summary.zh: 菲律宾发生强烈地震，造成至少61人死亡，并导致海底被抬升达2米，使珊瑚暴露并损害海洋生物。居民称，由于这种“海岸隆起”，海岸线向外延伸了多达200米。

body.en: ‘Coastal uplift’ exposes coral and kills marine life, as residents say shorelines extended by up to 200 metres A powerful earthquake that killed at least 61 people in the Philippines this week raised the seabed by as much as 2 metres (6.6 feet), exposing coral and harming marine life, the environment department said on Sunday. At least 40 people are still missing after the 7.8-magnitude tremor in southern Mindanao island on Monday, according to updated tolls from the disaster agency. Continue reading...
body.zh: “海岸隆起”暴露了珊瑚并杀死了海洋生物，居民称海岸线延长了 200 米菲律宾环境部门周日表示，本周菲律宾发生了一场强烈地震，造成至少 61 人死亡，海床上升了 2 米（6.6 英尺），暴露了珊瑚并伤害了海洋生物。据救灾机构最新统计，周一棉兰老岛南部发生 7.8 级地震，目前仍有至少 40 人失踪。继续阅读...

The Bible speaks of the whole creation groaning, a poignant image for the earth's seismic shifts and their devastating ecological consequences. In such moments, we are called to acknowledge the profound...
reflection.zh: 菲律宾发生的强烈地震，海底地貌被大幅抬升，珊瑚礁暴露并导致海洋生物死亡，这提醒我们受造界的脆弱。圣经提到“一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦”，这形象地描绘了地球的剧烈变动及其毁灭性的生态后果。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召去认识所有生命的深刻关联以及我们世界的脆弱性。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap, early projections say
title.zh: 瑞士选民初步预测否决1000万人口上限提案

summary.en: Early projections indicate that Swiss voters have rejected a proposal to cap the country's population at 10 million. Approximately 55% of participants voted against the measure, though not all votes have been counted.
summary.zh: 初步预测显示，瑞士选民否决了一项将国家人口上限设定为1000万的提案。尽管并非所有选票都已清点完毕，但目前趋势表明约有55%的参与者投了反对票。

body.en:
Voters in Switzerland have rejected a proposal to limit the country's population to 10 million, early projections suggest.

Not all votes have been counted, but the current trend suggests 55% of participants voted against, to 45% for.

The proposal came from the right-wing Swiss People's Party , which has long campaigned on an anti-immigration platform.

The divisive vote risked putting the country's free movement agreement with the European Union in jeopardy.

Switzerland's population has grown rapidly since 2002, when it stood at 7.3 million. Now it is 9.1 million, 27% of whom are Swiss residents who were born abroad.

However, the People Party's says that capping the population would reduce pressure on transport, housing and the environment seem not to have persuaded enough voters.

Many others were seemingly worried at the prospect of losing much-needed workers in tourism, hospitals, and care homes.

Others, in particular Swiss business leaders, feared losing Switzerland's crucial access to Europe's single market.

Over half of all Swiss products are sold into the EU, but their access to Europe's markets depends on Swiss commitment to Europe's free movement of people. Had the population cap been approved, Switzerland would have had to terminate that agreement.

It is also likely that some Swiss voters were nervous about a move which could leave their country isolated in what is a very unstable world.

Although neutral, Switzerland, like its neighbours in Europe, is spending more on defence, and has been exploring ways to co-ordinate more closely with European on security.

Switzerland's system of direct democracy means all major decisions are taken via the ballot box. Campaigners simply have to gather 100,000 signatures to ensure a nationwide vote.

body.zh: 早期预测显示，瑞士选民拒绝了将国家人口限制在 1000 万的提案。 并非所有选票都已清点，但目前的趋势表明，55% 的参与者投了反对票，45% 的参与者投了赞成票。 该提案来自右翼瑞士人民党，该党长期以来一直以反移民为竞选纲领。 这次分裂性的投票可能会危及该国与欧盟的自由流动协议。 自2002年以来，瑞士人口增长迅速，当时人口达到730万。现在这一数字已达 910 万，其中 27% 是在国外出生的瑞士居民。 然而，人民党声称限制人口将减轻交通、住房和环境压力，但似乎并没有说服足够多的选民。 其他许多人似乎担心旅游业、医院和疗养院可能会失去急需的工人。 其他人，尤其是瑞士商界领袖，则担心瑞士会失去进入欧洲单一市场的重要机会。 超过一半的瑞士产品销往欧盟，但它们进入欧洲市场的机会取决于瑞士对欧洲人员自由流动的承诺。如果人口上限获得批准，瑞士将不得不终止该协议。 一些瑞士选民也可能对此举感到紧张，因为此举可能会让瑞士在一个非常不稳定的世界中受到孤立。 尽管保持中立，瑞士与欧洲邻国一样，正在增加国防开支，并一直在探索与欧洲在安全问题上进行更密切协调的方法。 瑞士的直接民主制度意味着所有重大决定均通过投票箱做出。活动人士只需收集 10 万个签名即可确保全国投票。 此突发新闻报道正在更新，更多详细信息将很快发布。请刷新页面以获得完整版本。 您可以通过 BBC 新闻应用程序在智能手机或平板电脑上接收突发新闻。您还可以在 X 上关注 @BBCBreaking 以获取最新警报。

reflection.en: Debates about national population limits often touch on how societies welcome or integrate those from different backgrounds. The biblical call to treat foreigners as native-born reminds us of the shared humanity and dignity of all people. It encourages a spirit of hospitality and inclusion, reflecting a divine perspective on community.
reflection.zh: 关于国家人口上限的辩论，常触及社会如何接纳或融入不同背景的人群。圣经中将寄居者视同本地人的呼召，提醒我们所有人共享的人性和尊严。这鼓励了一种好客和包容的精神，反映了神对社群的看法。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Jamaican beach access campaigners go to court to fight privatisation of coast
title.zh: 牙买加海滩使用权倡导者上法庭，反对海岸私有化

summary.en: Activists in Jamaica are taking legal action to challenge colonial-era laws that have led to the privatization of beaches. They are demanding permanent, unrestricted public access to the coast, arguing that these natural resources belong to everyone.
summary.zh: 牙买加的活动人士正在采取法律行动，挑战导致海滩私有化的殖民时代法律。他们要求公众永久、不受限制地使用海岸，认为这些自然资源属于所有人。

body.en: Activists are challenging colonial-era law and demanding ‘free, legal, unfettered, forever rights’ to use beaches Jamaica’s beach access crisis: ‘We shouldn’t be forced to fight for what is already ours’ Campaigners in Jamaica are heading to court next week to try to prevent the government from cutting off access to more of their beaches. They argue that ceding their shorelines to big hotel chains enriches private investors and benefits tourists and outsiders while depriving Jamaicans who depend on the sea for their livelihoods, leisure and health. Continue reading...
body.zh: 活动人士正在挑战殖民时代的法律，要求拥有使用海滩的“自由、合法、不受限制、永远的权利”牙买加的海滩准入危机：“我们不应该被迫为已经属于我们的东西而战”牙买加的活动人士将于下周前往法庭，试图阻止政府切断更多海滩的使用权。他们认为，将海岸线割让给大型连锁酒店可以让私人投资者致富，让游客和外来者受益，同时剥夺依赖海洋谋生、休闲和健康的牙买加人的利益。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The fight for public beach access in Jamaica echoes a deep human longing for fairness and shared resources. When systems of power restrict what many believe is a common right, the call for justice can become a powerful, unyielding stream. This reminds us that the pursuit of righteousness often involves persistent advocacy for what is right and equitable for...
reflection.zh: 牙买加争取公共海滩使用权的斗争，反映了人类对公平和共享资源的深切渴望。当权力体系限制了许多人认为是共同权利的事物时，对正义的呼唤就会成为一股强大而持久的洪流。这提醒我们，追求公义往往需要为所有人争取正确和公平的事物而持续倡导。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Jamaica’s beach access crisis: ‘We shouldn’t be forced to fight for what is already ours’
title.zh: 牙买加的海滩准入危机：“我们不应该被迫为已经属于我们的东西而战”

summary.en: Activists argue business model is ‘plantation tourism’ designed to benefit elite and disadvantage most Jamaicans Campaigners go to court to fight privatisation of Jamaican coast Devon Taylor remembers when the Mammee Bay shoreline in St Ann, Jamaica, was filled with children...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Activists argue business model is ‘plantation tourism’ designed to benefit elite and disadvantage most Jamaicans Campaigners go to court to fight privatisation of Jamaican coast Devon Taylor remembers when the Mammee Bay shoreline in St Ann, Jamaica, was filled with children frolicking in the ocean after school, fishers haggling with locals over the price of their daily catch and craft vendors carving souvenirs under almond trees. “I grew up on Mammee Bay,” Taylor says. He recalls fetching seawater in bottles for his grandmother when she was no longer able to go to the beach, learning to swim in the shallows, and watching generations of fishers cast their nets. “That beach raised us. It fed us.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 活动人士认为，商业模式是“种植园旅游”，旨在让精英受益，让大多数牙买加人受益。活动人士上法庭反对牙买加海岸的私有化。德文·泰勒记得，牙买加圣安的曼米湾海岸线当时挤满了放学后在海里嬉戏的孩子，渔民与当地人就日常捕获物的价格讨价还价，手工艺品摊贩在杏树下雕刻纪念品。 “我在曼米湾长大，”泰勒说。他回忆起当祖母无法去海滩时，他用瓶子为她取海水，在浅滩学习游泳，并观看一代又一代的渔民撒网。 “那个海滩养育了我们。它养育了我们。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Farage vows to ban foreign nationals from social housing as byelection looms
title.zh: 法拉奇誓言禁止外国国民入住社会保障性住房，以应对补选

summary.en: Reform leader Nigel Farage has pledged to ban foreign nationals from social housing and deport those unable to find private accommodation, ahead of a byelection. He also claimed that "anti-whiteness is institutionalised" in the UK.
summary.zh: 改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇在补选前夕承诺，将禁止外国国民入住社会保障性住房，并驱逐那些无法找到私人住所的人。他还声称英国存在“制度化的反白人主义”。

body.en: Reform leader claims ‘anti-whiteness is institutionalised’ in UK as polls suggest Labour have lead in Makerfield UK politics live – latest updates Nigel Farage said he would ban foreign nationals from social housing and then deport them if they could not find private sector homes, in a hardening of anti-immigration rhetoric before the Makerfield byelection . It comes as two new polls in Makerfield suggests Farage’s Reform UK continues to leak potentially crucial support to its far-right rival Restore Britain, which is led by the former Reform MP Rupert Lowe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 改革领袖声称英国“反白人已经制度化”，因为民意调查显示工党在梅克菲尔德英国政坛领先——最新消息奈杰尔·法拉奇表示，他将禁止外国人入住社会住房，如果他们找不到私营部门的住房，他将禁止他们入住，然后将他们驱逐出境，这是梅克菲尔德补选前反移民言论的强化。与此同时，梅克菲尔德的两项新民意调查显示，法拉奇的英国改革派继续向其极右翼竞争对手“复兴英国”泄露潜在的关键支持，该党由前改革派议员鲁珀特·洛领导。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights a debate about who deserves access to basic provisions like social housing. Isaiah 58:7 reminds us that true compassion involves practical acts, such as providing shelter for the poor and displaced. This calls us to consider the human impact of policies on the most vulnerable among us, regardless of their origin.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻引发了关于谁有权获得社会住房等基本保障的讨论。以赛亚书58:7提醒我们，真正的怜悯在于实际行动，例如为贫困和流离失所者提供住所。这呼吁我们思考政策对我们中最脆弱群体的人道影响，无论他们来自何方。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Middle East crisis live: Trump says Iran deal will be signed today but sources tell media Tehran ‘not yet’ taken final decision
title.zh: 中东危机：特朗普称伊朗协议今日签署，德黑兰对其时机表示怀疑

summary.en: The news reports on a potential deal regarding the Strait of Hormuz, with President Trump indicating it could open the strait to all, but also warning of an "ultimate alternative" if talks fail. body.en:
Donald Trump celebrates his 80th birthday in typically forceful style on Sunday (local time), as the oldest US president holds a bloody cage match on the White House lawn.

The unprecedented UFC Freedom 250 event will see 14 Ultimate Fighting Championship stars beat each other to a pulp in a giant arena called The Claw.

Costing US$60 million ($85.1 million), it's linked to this year's festivities for the 250th anniversary of US independence — but it also falls on the day Trump enters his ninth decade.

Critics have derided the violent extravaganza in America's most famous backyard, saying it is in poor taste during a war with Iran that has sent prices soaring for ordinary people.

Trump may clinch a long-sought peace deal with Iran on his big day, although Tehran has cast doubt on that timing.

The billionaire president, who has deep ties with a sport whose young male fans reflect his own political base, defended the UFC event as a unique spectacle.

"This is going to be an event you're really gonna like," Trump said as he hosted some of the muscle-bound, bare-knuckle fighters in the Oval Office in May.

UFC chief content officer Craig Borsari denied that the UFC was blending sport with politics.

"The way we look at this is we have an unbelievable, incredibly unique opportunity to celebrate this country and our athletes," Borsari told a news conference this week.

In a dramatic touch, some of the top fighters taking part in Sunday's event are reportedly set to emerge from the Oval Office itself before marching out to the historic South Lawn.

The fights themselves will take place in the Octagon, an eight-sided wire mesh cage, surrounded by seats for more than 4,000 spectators.

UFC combatant Michael Chandler, who is fighting at the event, said it was the "biggest fight event in combat sports history".

"We're not in politics in any way, but we have the opportunity to be exposed to the eyes of the world — we have to take it," he told Agence France-Presse earlier this month.

There will be a nod to the 250th celebrations with historical "vignettes" between bouts, Axios reported, and there will also be military bands, a US military flyover and parachute display and a 10-minute fireworks finale.

Another battle has already been won. A US judge on Friday (local time) rejected a bid by two local residents to halt the fight on the grounds that the event was corrupt.

The fighters are being weighed in outside the Lincoln Memorial, and there's space for some 125,000 people to watch the event on giant screens on the National Mall.

title.en: Armed men kidnap high-ranking security official in Haiti
title.zh: 武装人员绑架海地高级安全官员

summary.en: James Boyard's abduction is the highest-ranking abduction in the violence-wracked country in recent years, according to reports.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Armed men in Haiti have kidnapped the defence minister's chief of staff, the highest-ranking official to be kidnapped in the violence-wracked Caribbean country in recent years.

Top security official James Boyard, who is also inspector general of Haiti's police, was seized in the island's capital Port-au-Prince on Thursday.

Both the Associated Press news agency and the New York Times confirmed his abduction via sources, with the newspaper adding Boyard's wife and six-year-old daughter were also taken.

A ransom has been requested, according to the New York Times, who cited a person familiar with the case.

Boyard, a highly respected security expert, is chief of staff to Mario Andrésol who was appointed in March.

Diego Da Rin, an analyst with the International Crisis Group, told AP news agency kidnappings are increasingly occurring in areas of Port-au-Prince once considered safe.

He added gang members have been kidnapping people with double nationalities and targeting public officials, which could mean they are trying to seek higher ransoms or possibly dissuade authorities from attacking gang-controlled areas where hostages are held.

Gang violence has ravaged the Caribbean country for years and the multinational police force sent to contain it has struggled to enter areas where gangs hold sway.

So far this year, gang-related violence has resulted in at least 2,310 deaths, 1,106 injuries and 99 kidnappings, according to the United Nations earlier this month.

It has also caused record levels of displacement with nearly 1.5 million people without a place to live, according to the latest figures released by the UN migration agency.
body.zh: 海地武装人员绑架了国防部长办公厅主任，这是近年来这个饱受暴力困扰的加勒比海国家被绑架的最高级别官员。 周四，高级安全官员兼海地警察总监詹姆斯·博亚德在该岛首府太子港被捕。 美联社和《纽约时报》都通过消息来源证实了他被绑架的消息，该报还补充说，博亚德的妻子和六岁的女儿也被绑架了。 据《纽约时报》援引一位知情人士的话称，已要求支付赎金。 博亚德是一位备受尊敬的安全专家，他是马里奥·安德烈索尔 (Mario Andrésol) 的幕僚长，后者于 3 月份被任命。 国际危机组织分析师迭戈·达林 (Diego Da Rin) 告诉美联社，在曾经被认为安全的太子港地区，绑架事件越来越多地发生。 他补充说，帮派成员一直在绑架双重国籍的人，并以公职人员为目标，这可能意味着他们试图寻求更高的赎金，或者可能劝阻当局不要袭击帮派控制的扣押人质的地区。 帮派暴力多年来一直肆虐这个加勒比国家，派去遏制暴力的多国警察部队一直难以进入帮派统治的地区。 据联合国本月早些时候的数据，今年迄今为止，与帮派相关的暴力事件已导致至少 2,310 人死亡、1,106 人受伤和 99 人绑架。 根据联合国移民机构发布的最新数据，这还造成了创纪录的流离失所现象，近 150 万人无家可归。

title.en: New York Knicks win NBA championship for first time in over 50 years
title.zh: 纽约尼克斯队五十多年来首次赢得NBA总冠军

summary.en: The Knicks clinched the title against the San Antonio Spurs, 94-90, in the fifth game of the best-of-seven series, marking their first NBA championship in over 50 years.
summary.zh: 纽约尼克斯队在七场四胜制的系列赛第五场中以94-90击败圣安东尼奥马刺队，夺得NBA总冠军，这是他们五十多年来的首次夺冠。

body.en:
The New York Knicks won the National Basketball Association championship for the first time in over 50 years, sending the city and fans into a frenzy after the long-awaited victory.

The Knicks clinched the title on Saturday night against the San Antonio Spurs, 94-90, in the fifth game of the best-of-seven series.

While the game was in Texas, New Yorkers took to their hometown streets in droves to watch and celebrate the milestone for fans and the city.

Some fans also made their way to Texas where the two teams faced off at the Frost Center, the Spurs' home arena.

Elizabeth Madigan flew to San Antonio from New York Friday night ahead of Saturday's game.

"I've been waiting for this, honestly most of my life. The last time the Knicks won, I was 6 months old, and so I can't begin to describe how excited I am. It's been unbelievable," she said.

This season has represented a stunning reversal of fortune for the Knicks after decades as one of the worst teams in the league. The last time they made it all the way to the finals was in 1999, also against the Spurs, who ultimately beat them. Their last finals win was even earlier, in 1973.

One fan who only gave his first name, Max, said that winning the game away from the Knicks' home arena in New York, Madison Square Garden, isn't important.

"I don't think it matters [that they won in Texas]. New York is going crazy right now and there's a million Knicks fans here right now, so it doesn't matter."

US President Donald Trump posted congratulations to the team and Knicks owner Jim Dolan, who invited him to game 3 of the series in New York.

"What a year it has been but, even more so, what incredible playoff wins we have all witnessed, especially the last four - Maybe the greatest in the history of basketball," the post read.

"This city is electric," said Jake Minicucci, while waiting with friends at a Manhattan sports bar for the game to start. "I've never gotten so many head nods, everybody knowing we are in it for the Knicks together."

The 50-plus year drought was very much on the minds of some Knicks fans including Daniel Brown who said the evening had the potential "to be one of the best nights in the history of this city."

"I've lived here all my life, I've never experienced anything like this," said the 24-year-old.

Fans celebrated into the early hours Sunday morning with crowds taking over parts of Midtown Manhattan, including several blocks near Times Square. Some subway lines were altered with trains skipping stations due to the large crowds.

"Through near misses, heartbreak and a hope that every year could be our year, this city never stopped believing in the Knicks," a statement from the mayor obtained by BBC news partner CBS said.

title.en: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
title.zh: 特朗普称美国空袭击毙委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目

summary.en: US President Donald Trump announced that Niño Guerrero, the leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang, was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike" by the United States.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目尼诺·格雷罗在美国的一次“迅速而致命的动能打击”中丧生。

body.en:
The US military has killed the leader of the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua in an air strike in the country, President Donald Trump has announced.

"At my direction, the United States Southern Command delivered a swift and lethal kinetic strike to successfully execute Niño Guerrero," Trump wrote on social media.

Niño Guerrero, whose full name is Héctor Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, was the longtime leader of Tren de Aragua. The gang is one of the most notorious criminal groups in Latin America and has been a target of the Trump administration.

The president has accused the group of engaging in "irregular warfare" against the US and declared it a foreign terrorist organisation.

Trump posted footage of what appears to be the airstrike, showing a green building with a nearby shed being blown up, debris flying into the air. He said the military action was "coordinated closely with our friends in Venezuela, with whom we are working very well".

Venezuelan authorities confirmed their involvement in what they described as a "joint operation".

US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said on X the strike took place earlier this week on a Tren de Aragua compound in Venezuela.

Later, Venezuela's communication ministry said Guerrero was killed in a "combined operation" with the US that targeted organised crime in the country's Bolívar state.

In January, American forces seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro from his compound in a dramatic overnight raid to face criminal charges in New York. The US accused him of collaborating with the gang. The indictment named Guerrero Flores as a co-conspirator.

Since then, the US has sought to tighten ties with Maduro's successor, Delcy Rodríguez, lifting sanctions on her and pushing to collaborate on the extraction of Venezuela's oil reserves - the most plentiful on earth.

Under Guerrero's leadership, Tren de Aragua expanded into Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Chile and diversified from extorting migrants into sex-trafficking, contract killing and kidnapping.

It was originally a prison gang that Niño Guerrero turned into a "transnational criminal organisation", according to the US state department, which had offered millions for information leading to his arrest.

Guerrero spent years in and out of prison. In 2012, he escaped by bribing a guard and was then rearrested in 2013.

Upon his return, he transformed the Tocorón Prison in the northern Venezuelan state of Aragua into a leisure complex, complete with zoo, restaurants, nightclub, betting shop and swimming pool.

title.en: Young Australian girl shot dead by police in Pakistan
title.zh: 澳洲女孩在巴基斯坦警方拙劣枪击中丧生

summary.en: An Australian girl was killed in Pakistan when local police opened fire on her family's rental car. The family was reportedly leaving the scene after being robbed at gunpoint.

body.en:
A nine-year-old Australian girl has been killed and two of her family members injured after being shot by police in Pakistan.

Local media reported the family were visiting a relative in Chakwal, in the Punjab province, when they were robbed while in their rental car on Wednesday night (local time).

Two robbers on a motorcycle, including one with a pistol, fled when they were spotted by an officer, and the rental car also drove off.

More police attended the scene and opened fire on the family's car, confusing them for the alleged robbers.

"As the cops saw the vehicle being driven away immediately, they took it as belonging to the robbers and opened indiscriminate fire on the car," a police official told local media.

The family from the Perth suburb of Kewdale was rushed to hospital, where the girl was pronounced dead.

Her father and older brother were seriously injured, while her mother was unharmed.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade confirmed it was providing consular assistance to the family of an Australian who was killed and to two Australians who were injured.

"We send our deepest condolences to the family at this difficult time," a department spokesperson said in a statement.

Pakistani Association of Western Australia general secretary Asim Chaudhry said the incident had left the local community downcast.

"This news is very shocking, especially the death of the nine-year-old," he told Nine News.

title.en: The World Cup could have given Donald Trump a boost. But it probably won't
title.zh: 世界杯本可助唐纳德·特朗普一臂之力，但可能不会

summary.en: Watched by billions, the World Cup is a perfect vehicle for showcasing one’s country, culture and values.
summary.zh: 拥有数十亿观众的世界杯是展示一个国家、其文化和价值观的绝佳平台。

body.en:
Every four years, it presents a unifying moment — bringing people together across the divides of language, culture and geography in a shared passion for the game.

For hosting nations, the World Cup is often a soft power supercharger. Watched by billions of people around the globe, it is a prime opportunity to showcase one’s country, culture and values.

This is all part of what’s known as sport diplomacy, or in this case “football diplomacy”. Beyond the trophies, governments invest in football to “win” off the pitch, too, in terms of fostering better relations, courting investment and earning global prestige.

There’s no question the United States could use a boost like this at the moment after 18 months of Donald Trump’s polarising leadership.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But, there’s a crucial difference between soft power and spectacle. Early signs suggest the 2026 World Cup will offer more of the latter for Trump’s America — an event that highlights power (not the soft kind), tribute, exclusion and vested interests.

The term “soft power” was coined in the 1990s by Harvard political scientist Joseph Nye Jr. It means a country’s power isn’t just derived from military force or economic weight (otherwise known as “hard power”), but also in its ability to influence through attraction.

Think South Korea’s K-pop phenomenon, the United Kingdom’s prestigious universities and the Nordic countries’ embrace of sustainability, good governance and progressive values.

In essence, this is the intangible power nations have to get others to sit at your table and consider, perhaps even support, your view of the world.

The concept has since evolved significantly since Nye developed it, and received heavy criticism. Critics are quick to point to its subversive potential, particularly when deployed by authoritarian states with less benign motives.

Political scientists Christopher Walker and Jessica Ludwig have introduced another term, “sharp power”, to describe how states, like Russia and China use their influence not to attract others, but to manipulate them.

Revisiting the topic more recently, Nye himself acknowledged that soft power has become more complicated. He recognises it can be gamed, misread or turned inward in ways that undermine the very openness it depends on.

The distinction is an important one today, reflecting a broader shift in how nations now use culture and spectacle as instruments of self-interest and dominance over others in a zero-sum world.

body.en:
Meet the women in Kerala’s film industry speaking out against sexual harassment and alleged exploitation by influential men. Tune in on SBS at 9.30pm Tuesday 16 June or watch live on SBS On Demand.

Priya (not her real name) was a young model with dreams of becoming an actor. So when she received a Facebook friend request from one of India’s biggest stars, Siddique, she thought she’d unlocked a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

"For me, he was a legend. He used to speak with me like an older person who’s caring for their daughter," Priya says.

She says the award-winning actor — then in his 50s — encouraged her ambitions and invited her to his hotel to discuss a film project in 2016.

During their meeting, Priya claims Siddique told the then-21-year-old she would need to "make adjustments" if she wanted to succeed. The term is commonly understood by women in the film industry as a demand for sexual favours.

"Slowly, he started touching my hand … I then realised that this was a great trap," Priya claims.

Priya alleges Siddique raped her then threatened to derail her career if she spoke publicly.

"[He said] 'you are not going to say anything to anyone ... Nobody is going to believe you. You and your profession are going to be affected by this'," she alleges.

Siddique has denied the accusations, describing them as a criminal conspiracy to tarnish the reputation of the entire Malayalam-language film industry.

While Bollywood has long dominated global perceptions of Indian cinema with its lavish Hindi-language musicals, Malayalam cinema or 'Mollywood' — based in the southern state of Kerala — releases about 200 films each year.

Its films are celebrated for their realism, complex characters and unconventional storytelling. But behind the critical acclaim lies a troubling reality, with stories like Priya’s commonplace.

For years, allegations of sexual harassment and abuse circulated quietly — but that changed in 2017.

One of Malayalam cinema's leading female actors was allegedly abducted in the city of Kochi and sexually assaulted inside a moving vehicle, as perpetrators filmed the incident.

Among those arrested and charged was one of Malayalam cinema’s biggest stars, Gopalakrishnan Padmanabhan, who goes by the screen name Dileep.

Prosecutors have accused him of orchestrating the attack. Dileep has denied the allegations and says he was wrongly accused.

Last year, after an eight-year legal battle, six men were convicted over the case and sentenced to 20-year prison sentences.

title.en: Germany faces EU penalty over gender pay gap directive
title.zh: 德国因性别薪酬差距指令面临欧盟处罚

summary.en: Germany was required to incorporate the EU Pay Transparency Directive into its national law, but it has missed the deadline.
summary.zh: 德国被要求将欧盟薪酬透明度指令纳入其国家法律，但已错过了最后期限。

body.en:
Germany was required to incorporate the EU Pay Transparency Directive into its national law, but it has missed the deadline.

Many people continue to earn less than others for the same job — often because of their gender. This is illegal, but difficult to prove. The EU Pay Transparency Directive, which takes effect across the European Union this month, is supposed to help make sure workers earn equal pay for the same job.

The new rules are designed to put more pressure on employers to ensure there is equal pay within their workforce. But Germany — the EU's largest, strongest, and most populous economy — has missed the June 7 deadline to implement the directive.

The pay gap between men and women in Germany remains an issue despite legal requirements to eliminate it. According to the German Federal Statistical Office, the adjusted gender pay gap was 6% in 2025, with women earning less than men in the same position and with the same qualifications.

The EU Pay Transparency Directive was introduced "to strengthen the application of equal pay for equal work or work of equal value between men and women through pay transparency and enforcement mechanisms." Once it takes effect, the idea is that employees should be able to request information to find out whether they are being paid unfairly for equivalent work and employers will be required to eliminated unjustified pay gaps.

The law relies on three mechanisms: The right to request information, gender pay gap reporting for larger companies, and joint pay assessments.

On May 6, the German government approved a bill to amend the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG) on the recommendation of German Education Minister Karin Prien, whose portfolio includes women's affairs, and Justice Minister Stefanie Hubig. The aim was to incorporate the EU's requirements into German law.  

"This is an important step toward putting our commitment to greater equality and effective action against discrimination into practice," said Prien. However, she attracted accusations that she had caved to the business lobby with her warning to "not place an unnecessary burden on government agencies and businesses and to keep procedures as simple as possible."

"The most important change is that anyone affected by discrimination will now have four months, rather than two, to decide whether they want to assert a claim according to the AGG," said Hubig as she presented the amendment. But this has apparently not convinced the European Commission.

body.zh: 德国被要求将欧盟薪酬透明度指令纳入其国家法律，但它已经错过了最后期限。 许多人从事同样的工作，收入仍然低于其他人——通常是因为他们的性别。这是非法的，但很难证明。本月在欧盟范围内生效的欧盟薪酬透明度指令应该有助于确保工人同工同酬。 新规则旨在向雇主施加更大压力，以确保其员工队伍中的同工同酬。但德国——欧盟最大、最强、人口最多的经济体——已经错过了 6 月 7 日执行该指令的最后期限。 尽管法律要求消除男女之间的工资差距，但德国男女之间的工资差距仍然是一个问题。德国联邦统计局的数据显示，到2025年，调整后的性别工资差距为6%，同等职位、同等资质下，女性的收入低于男性。 欧盟薪酬透明度指令的出台是为了“通过薪酬透明度和执行机制，加强男女同工同酬或同值工作同等报酬的适用”。一旦生效，员工应该能够索取信息，以查明他们在同等工作中是否获得了不公平的报酬，并且雇主将被要求消除不合理的薪酬差距。 该法律依赖于三种机制：索取信息的权利、大公司的性别薪酬差距报告以及联合薪酬评估。 5月6日，根据负责妇女事务的德国教育部长卡琳·普里恩（Karin Prien）和司法部长斯蒂芬妮·胡比格（Stefanie Hubig）的建议，德国政府批准了一项修改《普遍平等待遇法》（AGG）的法案。目的是将欧盟的要求纳入德国法律。 普里恩说：“这是将我们致力于实现更大平等和采取有效行动反对歧视的承诺付诸实践的重要一步。”然而，她受到了指责，称她向商业游说团体屈服，并警告“不要给政府机构和企业带来不必要的负担，并让程序尽可能简单”。 “最重要的变化是，任何受到歧视影响的人现在将有四个月而不是两个月的时间来决定是否要根据 AGG 提出索赔，”胡比格在提交修正案时说道。但这显然没有让欧盟委员会信服。 欧盟的薪酬透明度指令要求在申请过程中就实现透明度，要求雇主在出现重大薪酬差距的情况下采取纠正措施，并将举证责任从雇员转移到雇主。未来，雇主必须提供...

title.en: Anthropic cuts top-tier AI access after US foreigner ban
title.zh: Anthropic因美国禁止外国人访问而切断顶级AI服务

summary.en: Anthropic, an AI firm, announced it was ordered to block foreign nationals from accessing its advanced Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models. This decision was made on national security grounds by the US government.
summary.zh: 人工智能公司Anthropic宣布，已接到命令，禁止外国公民访问其先进的Fable 5和Mythos 5人工智能模型。美国政府基于国家安全理由做出了这一决定。

body.en:
The firm said it was ordered to block foreign nationals from accessing its state of the art Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models on national security grounds.

Anthropic said Friday it has cut access to two powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models after a United States  government order citing national security concerns.

The sudden block marks a major escalation in Anthropic’s growing showdown with the Trump administration after failed negotiations earlier this year over potential US military and intelligence use of its technology .

The order is potentially a major setback for Anthropic's plans to take the company public  later this year.

The San Francisco-headquartered firm said in a statement that it received a directive to block its Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 for all foreign nationals.

Fable 5 and Mythos 5 are the newest versions of the Claude AI model, released on June 9. The first is widely available to the public, while the latter is mostly restricted to vetted organizations.

The company said the ban applied to foreigners "whether inside or outside the United States, including foreign national Anthropic employees."

However, Anthropic said it had blocked access for all customers for now to ensure compliance.

"Our understanding is that the [US] government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or 'jailbreaking' Fable," the statement continued.

It said the company's own tests found only a small number of already-known bugs that were "minor vulnerabilities."

Anthropic said it was complying with the directive, but disagreed that the US government's findings "should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people."

It added that if this rule were applied across AI platforms, "we believe it would essentially halt all new model deployments for all frontier model providers."

Anthropic’s relationship with the US government broke down this year after the company refused to allow the military to use its AI models for domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons systems.

In response, the Pentagon added Anthropic to a supply chain blacklist , which is set to take effect later this year and could severely limit the company’s federal contracts.

This latest export ban marks the second major action by the Trump administration against the AI firm in just a few months.

The New York Times described the order as "unusually expansive," noting it could prevent Anthropic's employees in allied nations, including Canada or the United Kingdom, from using the AI models.

Earlier this month, US President Donald Trump signed an executive order requiring federal vetting of the most advanced AI systems for national security...
body.zh: 该公司表示，以国家安全为由，其被勒令禁止外国人访问其最先进的《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》人工智能模型。 Anthropic 周五表示，在美国政府以国家安全为由发布命令后，该公司已切断对两种强大人工智能 (AI) 模型的访问。 今年早些时候，就美国军事和情报部门可能使用其技术的谈判失败后，这次突然的封锁标志着 Anthropic 与特朗普政府日益激烈的对峙大幅升级。 该命令可能对 Anthropic 公司今年晚些时候上市的计划造成重大挫折。 这家总部位于旧金山的公司在一份声明中表示，它收到了一项指令，要求对所有外国人屏蔽其《克劳德寓言 5》和《克劳德神话 5》。 《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》是 Claude AI 模型的最新版本，于 6 月 9 日发布。第一个版本广泛向公众开放，而后者主要仅限于经过审查的组织。 该公司表示，该禁令适用于“无论是美国境内还是境外的外国人，包括 Anthropic 的外籍员工”。 不过，Anthropic 表示，为了确保合规性，目前已禁止所有客户访问。 “我们的理解是，[美国]政府认为它已经意识到一种绕过或‘越狱’Fable 的方法，”声明继续说道。 该公司表示，该公司自己的测试只发现了少数已知的“小漏洞”漏洞。 Anthropic 表示，它正在遵守该指令，但不同意美国政府的调查结果“应该成为召回部署到数亿人的商业模式的理由”。 它补充说，如果这条规则适用于人工智能平台，“我们相信它基本上会停止所有前沿模型提供商的所有新模型部署。” Anthropic 与美国政府的关系今年破裂，因为该公司拒绝允许军方将其人工智能模型用于国内监视和完全自主武器系统。 作为回应，五角大楼将 Anthropic 添加到供应链黑名单中，该名单将于今年晚些时候生效，可能会严重限制该公司的联邦合同。 这项最新的出口禁令标志着特朗普政府在短短几个月内针对这家人工智能公司采取的第二次重大行动。 《纽约时报》将这一命令描述为“异常广泛”，并指出它可能会阻止 Anthropic 在包括加拿大或英国在内的盟国的员工使用人工智能模型。 本月早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普签署了一项行政命令，要求联邦政府对最先进的人工智能系统进行国家安全审查……

title.en: US, Venezuela say Tren de Aragua leader killed in strike
title.zh: 美国和委内瑞拉称“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目在袭击中丧生

summary.en: US President Donald Trump announced that the leader of the Venezuela-based Tren de Aragua gang, which Washington has designated a terrorist organization, was killed in a US strike.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜列车”帮派的头目在美国的一次袭击中丧生。华盛顿已将该帮派列为恐怖组织。

body.en:
The leader of the Venezuela-based Tren de Aragua gang has died in a US strike, US President Donald Trump says. The gang has been labeled a terrorist organization by Washington.

The leader of the notorious Tren de Agua gang, Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, has been killed in a US strike in Venezuela , US President Donald Trump said on Friday.

The Trump administration has repeatedly accused Tren de Aragua of being behind much of the violence and drug dealing in many US cities.

Venezuela has confirmed the death of Guerrero Flores, saying he was killed during a "joint operation" with the US in the southeastern state of Bolivar.

Trump said the US had carried out a "swift and lethal kinetic" strike to kill Guerrero Flores, whom he called "the infamous leader” of the Tren de Aragua gang.

In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump wrote that "Tren de Aragua terrorists no longer have safe haven in Venezuela or anywhere else and, under my leadership, we will find these vicious murderers and drug lords anytime, anyplace, and send them to the depths of hell where they belong."

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth posted on X that the strike was carried out earlier in the week on one of the gang's compounds in Venezuela.

Rewards of up to $5 million (€4.32 million) had been offered by the US State Department for information that led to Guerrero Flores' arrest.

Venezuela's Ministry of Communications has confirmed the death in a statement about the operation at the compound. 

"There were clashes with members of these criminal structures, in which Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, alias 'Nino Guerrero,' was neutralized," it said.

Tren de Aragua came into being more than 10 years ago at a prison in Venezuela's central state of Aragua, where Guerrero Flores and other inmates took over control and administration as the country's economic crisis led to a neglect of jails.

Their power over the prison was such that they were able to turn the facility into a city-like structure with its own zoo, baseball field, casino and restaurants. 

The gang then expanded transnationally as  millions of Venezuelans emigrated in search of a better life.

Several countries, including Peru and Colombia, have accused the group of being behind rising violence in the region.

Guerrero Flores himself had racketeering, drug and firearms charges filed against him New York in December.

The Trump administration has also heavily targeted the gang, among other things with strikes in the eastern Pacific Ocean and Caribbean on small boats it says are smuggling drugs to the US.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，总部位于委内瑞拉的特伦·德·阿拉瓜帮派头目在美国的袭击中身亡。该团伙已被华盛顿列为恐怖组织。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五表示，臭名昭著的特伦·德·阿瓜帮派的头目赫克托·鲁斯滕福德·格雷罗·弗洛雷斯在美国对委内瑞拉的一次袭击中被杀。 特朗普政府多次指责特伦·德阿拉瓜是美国许多城市暴力和毒品交易的幕后黑手。 委内瑞拉证实了格雷罗·弗洛雷斯的死亡，称他是在与美国在东南部玻利瓦尔州的一次“联合行动”中被杀的。 特朗普表示，美国发动了“迅速而致命的动能”打击，杀死了格雷罗·弗洛雷斯，他称他为特伦·德·阿拉瓜帮的“臭名昭著的头目”。 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发帖写道，“特伦德阿拉瓜恐怖分子在委内瑞拉或其他任何地方都不再有避难所，在我的领导下，我们将随时随地找到这些恶毒的杀人犯和毒枭，并将他们送入他们所属的地狱深处。” 国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 在 X 上发帖称，本周早些时候，该团伙在委内瑞拉的一处营地遭到了袭击。 美国国务院悬赏高达 500 万美元（432 万欧元），奖励提供导致格雷罗·弗洛雷斯被捕的信息。 委内瑞拉交通部在一份有关该院落行动的声明中证实了这起死亡事件。 声明称：“与这些犯罪组织的成员发生了冲突，赫克托·鲁斯滕福德·格雷罗·弗洛雷斯（Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores，别名‘尼诺·格雷罗’）在冲突中被消灭。” 十多年前，特伦·德·阿拉瓜诞生于委内瑞拉中部阿拉瓜州的一所监狱，由于该国的经济危机导致监狱被忽视，格雷罗·弗洛雷斯和其他囚犯接管了监狱的控制和管理。 他们对监狱的权力如此之大，以至于他们能够将监狱变成一座类似城市的建筑，拥有自己的动物园、棒球场、赌场和餐馆。 随着数百万委内瑞拉人为了寻求更好的生活而移民，该团伙随后向跨国扩张。 包括秘鲁和哥伦比亚在内的多个国家指责该组织是该地区暴力事件不断升级的幕后黑手。 去年 12 月，格雷罗·弗洛雷斯 (Guerrero Flores) 本人在纽约遭到敲诈勒索、毒品和枪支指控。 特朗普政府还重点打击了该团伙，其中包括在东太平洋和加勒比海地区袭击了据称向美国走私毒品的小船。 特朗普过去曾声称该团伙在委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的控制下运作，...

title.en: Mercenaries and high-profile defectors abound in Sudan war
title.zh: 雇佣兵和高级叛逃者在苏丹战争中比比皆是

summary.en: Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.
summary.zh: 人权组织指责阿联酋支持快速支援部队民兵组织，该组织已有多名高级别成员叛逃至苏丹武装部队。与此同时，平民百姓继续遭受苦难。

body.en:
Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.

When Sudan's military leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan welcomed Al-Nour Ahmed Adam — also known as Al-Nour Al-Qubba and a former senior commander of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) militia — into the ranks of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) earlier this year, it was one of the most high-profile defections in the Sudanese civil war to date.

While the SAF controls the capital Khartoum, Port Sudan and large parts of the east and center of the country, its rival RSF holds vast areas in the west of the country, particularly in Darfur, including the city of El Fasher.

Al-Nour Al-Qubba is not the only defector: He was followed a few weeks later by high-ranking RSF commander, Ali Rizq Allah, also known as Al-Savannah.

Human Rights Watch (HRW) has reviewed videos purportedly showing these two defectors during the siege of El Fasher, where the international NGO has documented war crimes committed by the RSF , led by General Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, commonly known as Hemedti, during the city's capture in October 2025.

Since the war began in 2023 , Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has been trying to recruit defectors from the RSF into the SAF. Almost from the beginning, he declared a general amnesty for members of the militia if they laid down their arms, saying they could be integrated into the military. Human Rights Watch says it was unable to verify whether this also applied to the most recent defectors.

For Mohamed Osman, a Sudan researcher at Human Rights Watch, there must not be impunity. "Those responsible for serious international crimes and human rights violations do not get a free pass if they switch sides," he said, adding that "Sudanese people who have experienced horrific abuses under any commander's watch deserve justice."

According to conflict monitors at Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED), the recent defections could be a sign of increasing tension within the RSF ranks and of "cracks in the RSF's core alliances." They assume that "local loyalties are superseding central command, sparking violent intra-coalition competition over remaining war spoils."

The defections come at a time when both the SAF and the RSF have external support. Though the front is in Sudan, the alliances that are keeping the war going extend far beyond the country's borders. The RSF's supporters are believed to include the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Ethiopia , Libya , Chad and Kenya . The SAF, which has also been accused of war crimes, is supported by Egypt , Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Eritrea. Iran is also suspected of having provided military...
body.zh: 人权组织指责阿联酋支持 RSF 民兵，该民兵中有许多引人注目的叛逃者加入苏丹武装部队。与此同时，平民继续遭受苦难。 今年早些时候，苏丹军事领导人阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉 (Abdel Fattah al-Burhan) 欢迎努尔·艾哈迈德·亚当 (Al-Nour Ahmed Adam)（又名 Al-Nour Al-Qubba，快速支援部队 (RSF) 民兵前高级指挥官）加入苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 队伍，这是迄今为止苏丹内战中最引人注目的叛逃事件之一。 虽然苏丹武装部队控制着首都喀土穆、苏丹港以及该国东部和中部的大部分地区，但其竞争对手无国界武装部队控制着该国西部的大片地区，特别是在达尔富尔，包括法希尔市。 努尔·库巴并不是唯一的叛逃者：几周后，无国界部队高级指挥官阿里·里兹克·阿拉（Ali Rizq Allah，也被称为阿尔·萨凡纳）也追随了他。 人权观察组织 (HRW) 审查了据称显示这两名叛逃者在法希尔围困期间的视频，该国际非政府组织记录了穆罕默德·哈姆丹·达格洛将军（俗称赫梅蒂）领导的无国界部队在 2025 年 10 月占领该市期间犯下的战争罪行。 自 2023 年战争爆发以来，阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉一直试图招募无国界医生组织的叛逃者加入苏丹武装部队。几乎从一开始，他就宣布对放下武器的民兵成员实行大赦，并称他们可以编入军队。人权观察表示，无法核实这是否也适用于最近的叛逃者。 对于人权观察组织的苏丹研究员穆罕默德·奥斯曼来说，决不能有罪不罚。他说：“那些对严重国际罪行和侵犯人权行为负有责任的人，如果他们倒戈，就不会获得自由通行证。”他补充说，“在任何指挥官的监督下经历过可怕虐待的苏丹人民都应该受到正义的对待。” 根据武装冲突地点和事件数据项目 (ACLED) 的冲突监测员的说法，最近的叛逃可能是无国界医生组织内部紧张局势加剧以及“无国界医生组织核心联盟出现裂痕”的迹象。他们认为“地方忠诚正在取代中央指挥，引发了联盟内部对剩余战利品的激烈竞争。” 这些叛逃发生在新加坡武装部队和无国界部队都得到外部支持的情况下。尽管前线在苏丹，但维持战争持续的联盟却远远超出了该国的边界。据信，无国界医生组织的支持者包括阿拉伯联合酋长国（阿联酋）、埃塞俄比亚、利比亚、乍得和肯尼亚。苏丹武装部队也被指控犯有战争罪，得到埃及、沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和厄立特里亚的支持。伊朗还被怀疑提供了军事...

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict in Sudan, marked by external support for militias and the suffering of civilians, highlights a profound failure to uphold basic human dignity. Micah 6:8 reminds us that what God requires is to do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly, a standard that applies to all nations and actors involved in such conflicts.
reflection.zh: 苏丹持续的冲突，以对民兵的外部支持和平民的苦难为标志，凸显了未能维护基本人类尊严的严重失败。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，雅伟所要求的是行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与祂同行，这一标准适用于所有卷入此类冲突的国家和行为者。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: China Desk
title.zh: 中国观察

strap.en: Policy signals, social change, and national developments inside China.
strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: Jessie J’s triumphant return puts lucrative Chinese market in spotlight
title.zh: Jessie J的凯旋归来使利润丰厚的中国市场备受关注

summary.en: British pop star Jessie J made a triumphant return to the lucrative Chinese music market, a week after announcing she was cancer-free. Her success in the country's music scene has inspired other Western acts to seek similar opportunities since her breakout in 2018.
summary.zh: 英国流行歌星Jessie J在宣布自己“癌症痊愈”一周后，凯旋回归利润丰厚的中国音乐市场。自2018年她在中国取得突破性成功以来，她的经历也激励了其他西方艺人寻求类似的机会。

body.en: Other western acts have attempted to crack country’s music scene since singer’s breakout success in 2018 One week after announcing she was “cancer free”, the British pop star Jessie J did what any recovering patient would do and travelled thousands of miles around the world to perform for an audience of more than a billion people. On 29 May, the singer-songwriter, whose real name is Jessica Cornish, belted out a stage-rattling rendition of Frank Sinatra’s My Way on the stage of Singer, a hugely popular Chinese singing competition similar to The Voice. She also performed her new song, California, briefly adapting the lyrics to change California to Changsha, the Chinese city where Singer is hosted. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自 2018 年歌手取得突破性成功以来，其他西方艺人也试图闯入乡村音乐界。在宣布自己“癌症痊愈”一周后，英国流行歌星杰西·J (Jessie J) 做了任何康复患者都会做的事情，长途跋涉到世界各地为超过 10 亿观众表演。 5 月 29 日，这位真名杰西卡·康尼什 (Jessica Cornish) 的创作型歌手在《歌手》舞台上高声演唱了弗兰克·辛纳屈 (Frank Sinatra) 的《我的路》(My Way)。《歌手》是一项与《好声音》类似的非常受欢迎的中国歌唱比赛。她还演唱了她的新歌《加州》，简单地修改了歌词，将加州改为《歌手》所在的中国城市长沙。继续阅读...

reflection.en: After facing a serious illness, Jessie J's return to the stage embodies a powerful message of renewed strength and purpose. Her journey reminds us that even after periods of great weakness, there is hope for soaring again, finding fresh vigor for the path ahead.
reflection.zh: 面对重疾之后，Jessie J重返舞台，这体现了力量和目标重获新生的有力信息。她的旅程提醒我们，即使在极度虚弱之后，仍有希望再次翱翔，为前方的道路找到新的活力。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: China arrests US academic at conference for ‘espionage activities’
title.zh: 中国逮捕一名美国学者，指控其从事“间谍活动”

summary.en: A US academic, Min Zin, known for his writings on Myanmar and Chinese foreign policy, has been arrested in China on suspicion of engaging in espionage activities. This arrest occurred just a month after a high-profile visit by the US President to Beijing.
summary.zh: 一名撰写缅甸和中国外交政策的美国学者敏欣（Min Zin）在中国被捕，涉嫌从事间谍活动。此次逮捕发生在美国总统访问北京仅一个月后。

body.en: Arrest of Min Zin, who writes about Myanmar and Chinese foreign policy, comes just month after Trump visit to Beijing China has arrested a US scholar who writes about Myanmar and Chinese foreign policy on suspicion of spying. Min Zin was suspected of “engaging in espionage activities that endanger China’s national security,” China’s ministry of foreign affairs spokesperson, Lin Jian, said on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特朗普访问北京一个月后，撰写有关缅甸和中国外交政策的文章的敏津被捕，中国逮捕了一名撰写有关缅甸和中国外交政策的美国学者，涉嫌从事间谍活动。中国外交部发言人林健周五表示，敏津涉嫌“从事危害中国国家安全的间谍活动”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The arrest of an academic on espionage charges highlights the vulnerability of individuals when state power is wielded without clear accountability. Proverbs reminds us that when rulers act oppressively, the people are left in a precarious position. In such times, we pray for justice and for those who face arbitrary detention.
reflection.zh: 一名学者因间谍指控被捕，凸显了当国家权力在缺乏明确问责的情况下被行使时，个人所面临的脆弱性。箴言提醒我们，当统治者行事压迫时，人民就处于危险的境地。在这样的时刻，我们为正义和那些面临任意拘留的人祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: ‘Spy turtles’ and ‘spy fish’ being used to monitor Chinese waters, Beijing claims
title.zh: 北京声称“间谍海龟”和“间谍鱼”被用于监视中国水域

summary.en: China's Ministry of State Security has alleged that foreign intelligence agencies are employing "spy turtles" and "spy fish" equipped with sensors to gather sensitive data in Chinese waters. The ministry described these activities as part of an "invisible secret war."
summary.zh: 中国国家安全部声称，外国情报机构正在利用配备传感器的“间谍海龟”和“间谍鱼”来收集中国水域的敏感数据。该部将这些活动描述为“无形秘密战争”的一部分。

body.en: Ministry says animals fitted with sensors by foreign agencies collect sensitive sea data, in ‘invisible secret war’ China’s ministry of state security has claimed that foreign espionage and intelligence agencies are using innovative new methods to monitor the country’s waters, including deploying “spy” animals fitted with sensors. In a post on the Chinese platform WeChat on Friday, the ministry warned that an “invisible secret war” was quietly playing out in the seas around China as foreign agencies were collecting sensitive data “through a variety of new spying devices” to produce underwater maps that pose a “serious threat to our national security”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 外交部表示，外国机构安装传感器的动物在“看不见的秘密战争”中收集敏感的海洋数据 中国国家安全部声称，外国间谍和情报机构正在使用创新的新方法来监视该国水域，包括部署安装有传感器的“间谍”动物。周五，中国国防部在中国微信平台上发帖警告称，一场“看不见的秘密战争”正在中国周边海域悄然上演，外国机构“通过各种新型间谍设备”收集敏感数据，以制作水下地图，“对我们的国家安全构成严重威胁”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report of an "invisible secret war" reminds us that conflicts often run deeper than what is immediately visible. The Apostle Paul reminds us that our struggles are not merely against human adversaries, but against unseen forces that can fuel suspicion and division. In such times, it is wise to remember the spiritual dimensions at play, seeking...
reflection.zh: 这份关于“无形秘密战争”的报道提醒我们，冲突往往比表面上看到的更深层。使徒保罗提醒我们，我们的争战并非仅与人对抗，而是与那些可能助长猜疑和分裂的看不见的力量对抗。在这样的时刻，明智的做法是记住其中存在的属灵层面，寻求超越表面指控的洞察力。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: China has long sought to control women’s bodies. Increasingly, they’re making their own choices
title.zh: 中国长期寻求控制女性身体，但她们正日益做出自己的选择

summary.en: Chinese women are increasingly asserting their reproductive choices, pushing back against decades of state control, including the lasting impact of the one-child policy. Since 1949, the state has historically dictated women's bodies and labor.
summary.zh: 面对国家长期以来的压力以及独生子女政策的深远影响，越来越多的中国女性正在自主做出她们的生育选择。自1949年中华人民共和国成立以来，女性的身体一直被视为国家事务。

body.en: More women are rejecting state pressure over their reproductive choices, amid the devastating legacy of the one-child policy Ever since the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, women’s bodies have been the business of the state. In the 1950s, labour for state-controlled work units was organised according to women’s menstrual cycles. Then for decades, there was the one-child policy. Across vast swathes of the country the policy was enforced with a brutal severity. As well as fines for additional children, women were forced to have abortions and subjected to forced sterilisations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在独生子女政策造成的毁灭性影响中，越来越多的女性拒绝接受国家对她们生育选择的压力。自 1949 年中华人民共和国成立以来，女性的身体一直是国家的事。 20世纪50年代，国家控制的单位的劳动是根据妇女的月经周期来组织的。然后几十年来，一胎政策一直存在。在全国大片地区，这项政策得到了残酷的严厉执行。除了对额外孩子处以罚款外，妇女还被迫堕胎和强制绝育。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights a profound human desire for autonomy over one's own body, especially in deeply personal matters like reproduction. This resonates with the biblical truth that our bodies are not our own, but temples of the Holy Spirit, entrusted to us by God. It reminds us that ultimate authority over our lives and bodies rests with our Creator, not with...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了人们对身体自主权的深切渴望，尤其是在生育等极其私人的事务上。这与圣经的真理不谋而合，即我们的身体不属于自己，而是圣灵的殿，是神托付给我们的。它提醒我们，对我们生命和身体的最终主权在于我们的创造主，而非任何世俗权力。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own.
verse.textZh: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里面的。并且你们不是自己的人。

title.en: Thai court sentences two Uyghur men to death for 2015 Bangkok bombing
title.zh: 泰国法院判处两名维吾尔族男子死刑，罪名是2015年曼谷爆炸案

summary.en: A Thai court has sentenced two Uyghur men to death for their involvement in the 2015 Bangkok bombing at the Erawan Shrine, which killed 20 people and injured 120.
summary.zh: 泰国法院判处两名维吾尔族男子死刑，罪名是他们参与了2015年曼谷四面佛神庙爆炸案，该案造成20人死亡，120人受伤。

body.en: Twenty people were killed and 120 injured in the attack at the Erawan Shrine, a popular tourist destination A Thai court has handed out death sentences to two Uyghur men from the north-western Chinese region of Xinjiang for a 2015 bombing in the centre of Bangkok that killed 20 people. The explosion occurred at the Erawan Shrine in the centre of Bangkok, an area popular with foreign tourists. As well as the 20 people killed, another 120 were injured. Five of the dead were from mainland China and two from Hong Kong. Continue reading...
body.zh: 热门旅游胜地四面佛发生袭击事件，造成 20 人死亡、120 人受伤。泰国法院对两名来自中国西北部新疆地区的维吾尔男子判处死刑，他们因 2015 年曼谷市中心发生的爆炸事件造成 20 人死亡。爆炸发生在曼谷市中心的四面佛，这里是外国游客喜爱的地区。除20人死亡外，另有120人受伤。死者中有五名来自中国大陆，两名来自香港。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic sentencing of these men for the horrific Bangkok bombing underscores the devastating consequences of violence. Jesus' words remind us that those who initiate violence often face severe repercussions, highlighting the destructive cycle that harms all involved. This solemn outcome serves as a stark reminder of the ultimate cost of resorting to such...
reflection.zh: 这些男子因曼谷爆炸案被判处死刑的悲剧性判决，凸显了暴力的毁灭性后果。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些诉诸暴力的人常常面临严重的报应，这突显了伤害所有参与者的破坏性循环。这一庄严的结局，是对诉诸此类行为最终代价的严峻警示。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: China’s Jingye seeks compensation from UK over British Steel takeover
title.zh: 中国敬业集团就收购英国钢铁公司一事向英国寻求赔偿

summary.en: China's Jingye Group is seeking over £1 billion in compensation from the UK government, initiating a formal process under an international treaty. This dispute, stemming from its takeover of British Steel, could strain relations between the two countries.
summary.zh: 中国敬业集团已根据一项国际条约启动正式程序，向英国政府索赔超过10亿英镑。这起源于其收购英国钢铁公司的纠纷，可能会给两国关系带来压力。

body.en: Sources say firm is asking for more than £1bn in row that could put pressure on two countries’ relationship Business live – latest updates The Chinese owner of British Steel has started a formal process under an international treaty to win compensation from the UK government over its decision to nationalise the Scunthorpe steelworks. Jingye Steel said it would seek to recover money via China’s bilateral investment treaty with the UK, after more than a year of negotiations over the size of any payout. The dispute could put pressure on the relationship between China and the UK. Continue reading...
body.zh: 消息人士称，该公司连续索要超过 10 亿英镑，这可能会给两国关系带来压力。 英国钢铁公司的中国所有者已根据一项国际条约启动正式程序，争取英国政府就其将斯肯索普钢铁厂国有化的决定做出赔偿。敬业钢铁表示，在就支付金额进行了一年多的谈判后，将寻求通过中国与英国的双边投资条约收回资金。这场争端可能会给中英关系带来压力。继续阅读...

reflection.en: International disputes, even those rooted in business, can test the fabric of diplomatic relations. In such moments, the call to pursue peace, as far as it depends on us, becomes a guiding principle for all parties involved. Seeking fair resolution while striving to maintain respectful relationships is a challenging but vital endeavor.
reflection.zh: 国际争端，即使是源于商业的争端，也会考验外交关系的韧性。在这样的时刻，尽力与众人和睦相处，成为所有相关方的指导原则。在寻求公平解决方案的同时，努力维护相互尊重的关系，是一项充满挑战但至关重要的工作。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: China’s BYD aims to be world’s biggest car firm within five years
title.zh: 中国比亚迪目标五年内成为全球最大汽车公司

summary.en: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD has announced its ambitious goal to become the world's largest car firm within the next five years, aiming to surpass Toyota. The company plans a significant investment of £1.8bn to develop five-minute flash chargers in Europe as part of its expansion strategy.
summary.zh: 中国电动汽车制造商比亚迪宣布其宏伟目标，即在未来五年内超越丰田，成为全球最大的汽车公司。作为其扩张战略的一部分，该公司计划投资18亿英镑在欧洲开发五分钟闪充充电器。

body.en: EV maker aims to overtake Toyota, as it plans to spend £1.8bn to build five-minute flash chargers in Europe Business live – latest updates The Chinese car company BYD has said it aims to be the world’s biggest automaker within the next five years. Targeting Toyota’s long-held top spot, BYD’s founder and chair, Wang Chuanfu said he was confident it could overtake global rivals through rapid advances in battery technology and fast charging, as well as growing production overseas, including Europe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 电动汽车制造商的目标是超越丰田，计划斥资 18 亿英镑在欧洲生产五分钟闪存充电器 商业直播 - 最新动态 中国汽车公司比亚迪表示，其目标是在未来五年内成为全球最大的汽车制造商。针对丰田长期占据的领先地位，比亚迪创始人兼董事长王传福表示，他有信心通过电池技术和快速充电技术的快速进步，以及包括欧洲在内的海外生产的增长，比亚迪能够超越全球竞争对手。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of ambitious goals, like becoming a global industry leader, requires immense planning, effort, and strategic investment. For those who seek to honor God in their endeavors, Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to 雅伟, trusting that He will establish our plans. This perspective encourages diligence while acknowledging a higher source of...
reflection.zh: 追求宏伟目标，例如成为全球行业领导者，需要巨大的规划、努力和战略投资。对于那些在事业中寻求荣耀神的人来说，箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们所做的一切交托给雅伟，相信他会使我们的计划得以实现。这种观点鼓励勤奋，同时也承认智慧和成功的更高源泉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Chinese activist in UK told by X that abusive deepfakes do not breach rules
title.zh: 中国活动家在英国被告知，X平台认为其遭受的深度伪造辱骂不违反规定

title.en: 'Important consensus': What we know about Xi Jinping's North Korean visit
title.zh: “重要共识”：我们对习近平访问朝鲜的了解

summary.en: The Chinese President has made his first visit to North Korea since 2019, marking an important diplomatic engagement between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国国家主席自2019年以来首次访问朝鲜，标志着两国之间一次重要的外交接触。

body.en:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has visited North Korea for a series of meetings with leader Kim Jong Un.

The pair reached an "important consensus" on the nation's ties in a "new era", according to Xi.

Xi arrived in the North Korean capital Pyongyang on Monday for his first official visit to the diplomatically isolated nation since 2019.

He travelled with his wife and several other top officials for a two-day trip, he said, aimed to bring ties between the longtime partners to "new heights".

The visit follows Xi's hosting of a string of world leaders, including US President Donald Trump and Russia's Vladimir Putin, in Beijing.

State media images showed Xi and Kim beaming as they shook hands, with the Chinese leader receiving a lavish welcome ceremony featuring a red-carpet military salute and cheering crowds.

Xi said he had reached "an important consensus with Kim on developing China-DPRK relations in the new era", China's Xinhua news agency reported, using North Korea's official acronym.

The leaders agreed to put the two nations' friendly relations "on a more solid basis", North Korea's official Korean Central News Agency said.

Chinese state media reported Xi told Kim their countries "should strengthen exchanges in diplomacy, law enforcement [and] the military" and expand economic cooperation.

He also called for expanded economic cooperation, citing the recent reopening of border crossings and transport links.

China has long been North Korea's largest economic partner, with US and South Korean estimates indicating that China has accounted for almost all of North Korea's annual foreign trade in recent years.

In March, flights and passenger train services between the two nations resumed after a six-year hiatus due to pandemic-era border closures and their aftermath.

Official readouts and state media reports have not said whether Xi and Kim discussed North Korea's nuclear weapons development, for which the nation languishes under international sanctions.

Last month, the White House announced that the Chinese leader and Trump had "confirmed their shared goal to denuclearise North Korea" during their summit in Beijing.

Kim has repeatedly vowed never to give up his nuclear arsenal, and his sister said before Xi's visit that the program was North Korea's "line of no retreat".

The absence of denuclearisation from official statements means the summit effectively "appeared to have been a forum where China granted Pyongyang's rights to nuclear weapons", Lee Ho-ryung of the Korea Institute for Defence Analyses told AFP.

title.en: 'Taken a toll': Rising Liberal star to quit politics
title.zh: “造成了损失”：自由党新星将退出政坛

summary.en: A Liberal senator, who has served 25 years in politics, announced his resignation, stating the role had "taken a toll" and he had been considering the decision for some time.
summary.zh: 一位在政坛服务了25年的自由党参议员宣布辞职，他表示这份工作“造成了损失”，并且他已经考虑这个决定“一段时间”了。

body.en:
Declining poll numbers for the Liberals were not a factor in one of the party's frontbenchers deciding to retire from federal politics.

Opposition home affairs spokesman Jonathon Duniam will not seek re-election for his Tasmanian Senate seat.

The 43-year-old said he wanted to step back from politics after 10 years in federal parliament to spend more time with his family, including his three children.

"Ten years, on top of 15 years prior to that of being in and around politics, 25 years of my life dedicated to long hours and being away from home a lot has taken a toll on my family," he told reporters in Hobart on Sunday.

"This job has been a very serious one, and as a result, has taken up a lot of time and a lot of energy.

"It is odd to fight hard to get in. It's even odder when you fight harder to stay and then to pull up stumps.

"When family come into it, you can't think twice about it. Your priorities become very, very clear."

The loss of senator Duniam was another blow for the Liberal Party, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke said.

"The Liberal Party lose one of their best and brightest when he leaves the parliament," he told Sky News on Sunday.

Senator Duniam said poll numbers had not influenced his decision to retire, despite a surge in One Nation's primary vote placing the party ahead of Labor and the Coalition.

"This is something that we've been weighing up, and my team, my colleagues in Canberra, trusted friends know that I've been weighing this up for a while," he said.

"A good friend of mine told me graveyards are full of indispensable people and at the end of the day, someone else is going to take my place."

Senator Duniam first entered federal politics at the 2016 election, when he became the only new Tasmanian member of the upper house.

He came to Canberra after previously serving as an adviser to former Tasmanian Liberal senator Eric Abetz, and later as a deputy chief of staff to Tasmanian premier Will Hodgman.

He served as an assistant minister for forestry and fisheries in Scott Morrison's government and later held the opposition spokesman role for the portfolio following the Liberals' 2022 election defeat.

Senator Duniam became the opposition home affairs spokesman after Angus Taylor took over as opposition leader in February.

He said his long lead time for his retirement would allow a successor to build up a profile before the next election, which must be held before May 2028.

"I discussed my decision with Angus some time ago and he has asked me to continue for a short period of time to complete work on our immigration policies," he said.

title.en: Australia 'relies on immigration' and restricting numbers could backfire, government warns
title.zh: 澳大利亚政府警告称，国家“依赖移民”，限制移民数量可能适得其反

summary.en: The Australian federal government has issued a warning that significantly reducing migrant numbers would worsen the country's situation, emphasizing the nation's reliance on immigration.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦政府警告称，大幅减少移民数量将使国家状况恶化，强调该国对移民的依赖。

body.en:
Migration opponents are being warned that big cuts to Australia's intake numbers would cause havoc for the economy and impact housing targets.

Immigration minister Tony Burke said immigration and housing numbers were out of balance with each other but dramatic cuts to intake numbers were not the solution.

Appearing on Sky News on Sunday ahead of the release of net overseas migration numbers on Thursday, Burke said the government has decreased net migration by 45 per cent.

"We're continuing to cut it. We're continuing to make sure it's tailored to the needs of the nation," he said.

"But what we will not do is create a situation where the people building houses can't get workers, or a situation where your local community, particularly in the regions, can't get a doctor.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"There are parts of the economy that absolutely rely on immigration, and there is no way in the world that we want to jeopardise that."

The federal government is targeting a net overseas migration level of 225,000 people each year in the next three years after numbers spiked following the COVID-19 pandemic.

The figure for the 2024/25 financial year was 306,000 people — down from 429,000 the year before.

Burke said the figures needed to be finely tuned to have the best impact on housing numbers.

"We need to keep doing what we can to increase housing supply, and we need to make sure migration is tailored to what we can do there," he said.

"If you go at migration the wrong way, then you can actually make the housing situation worse."

Opposition Leader Angus Taylor used his budget reply speech in May to outline Coalition plans to link immigration levels to the number of homes being built each year.

He said the plan was aimed at curbing mass migration, but did not provide an answer on what the numbers would be.

One Nation has proposed a cap of 130,000 visa places each year under its policy.

Opposition frontbencher Phillip Thompson said the federal government was unlikely to meet its immigration targets.

"I just look at where we've been historically and what we've, what we've seen over the last few years," he told Sky News.

"I definitely don't want to see any more ISIS supporters come to Australia, and I'd like to see the temporary exclusion order used more."

title.en: Calls for culls after 'unique and different' shark attack off Sydney beach
title.zh: 悉尼海滩附近发生“独特而不同寻常”的鲨鱼袭击事件后，呼吁捕杀鲨鱼的声音日益高涨

summary.en: Calls to cull sharks are growing louder after a woman was critically injured by a shark at one of Australia's best-known beaches.

body.en:
The latest shark attack that critically injured a woman in front of shocked swimmers at a popular Sydney beach has reignited calls for culling.

The attack happened about 20-30 metres from shore and between the flags at Sydney's popular Coogee Beach about 11am on Saturday.

The woman, believed to be in her 30s, was airlifted to hospital after being brought from the water by an off-duty lifeguard.

It has prompted strong calls by NSW independent MP Rod Roberts to cull sharks for the sake of community safety.

"Nothing is off the table in terms of how we keep the community safe," she told reporters.

Shark nets would be installed on 1 September and the government was seeking expert advice from the Department of Primary Industries, Ms Moriarty said.

"We swim in the ocean with living, breathing animals and we have to share the ocean every day," she said.

"We're not talking about culling out on the Great Barrier Reef, just the popular swimming areas around Sydney," he said.

Marine experts and conservationists warn culling is not a sustainable, scientifically grounded solution.

Footage from a Westpac Life Saving Rescue Helicopter shows a large shark swimming close to the shore after the attack.

All of Sydney's eastern suburbs beaches remain closed after Randwick City Council made the call to prohibit anyone entering the surf during the 24 hours following the attack.

The closure includes Coogee, Clovelly and Maroubra beaches, and "all other ocean beaches under council management".

Surf Life Saving NSW officials said the woman was taken to St Vincents Hospital with serious arm and leg injuries but was "semi-conscious and breathing".

Guards stationed at the beach responded immediately, administering emergency first aid and CPR before paramedics arrived, Randwick mayor Dylan Parker said.

The shark involved is believed to be three-to-four metres long and possibly a Great White, which is a protected species.

An exemption to fly drones has been sought by SLNSW from the Civil Aviation Safety Authority, Ms Moriarty confirmed.

The Department of Primary Industries and Fisheries shark programs leader Marcel Green said Saturday's attack was "unique and different".

"She (the swimmer) was doing everything right but it was just one of those random events and we can never be protected 100 per cent every day, all the time," he said.

About 170 white sharks have been detected by the department's listening stations dotted across the entirety of the state's coastline.

Coogee Surf Life Saving Club will host a community gathering on Monday at 6.30pm.

title.en: As voter disillusionment grows, why aren't voters flocking to the Greens in Australia?

summary.en: Growing voter dissatisfaction with mainstream politics in Australia has led to an increase in support for the One Nation party, while the Greens have not seen a similar surge in popularity despite the widespread disillusionment.

body.en:
The rise of One Nation may not come as a surprise to anyone who has been watching politics in the US, the UK and the rest of Europe in recent years.

But Australia's belated embrace of right-wing populism is perhaps more unusual because of what has happened on the other side of the political spectrum.

Why have the Greens not been able to capitalise on disillusion with mainstream parties and the hollowing out of the political centre, as their counterparts in the US and the UK have?

Since the last federal election in May 2025, One Nation has surged in opinion polls to become the most popular party in the land, with about 30 per cent of the first-preference vote.

The Greens, meanwhile, have barely budged from their haul of 12 per cent at the last election.

In the same period, the Green Party of England and Wales, under leader Zack Polanski, has increased its voter share from 10 per cent to 18 per cent in recent local government elections.

It turns out they are but only in certain demographics, Redbridge polling analyst Kos Samaras says.

Among Generation Z voters, who were born after 1996, the Greens vote is more than 30 per cent — significantly higher than that of millennial voters at the same age.

"Generation Z is absolutely different to every other generation that's come before them," Samaras told the Australian Associated Press (AAP).

The reason the overall Greens vote has stayed relatively stable is that they're losing support amongst older Australians — to Labor, the teal independents and, to a lesser extent, One Nation.

Polanski told a Victorian Greens conference in May the party needed to take on One Nation and connect with the anger of voters deserting the major parties.

Echoing Polanski, Greens leader Larissa Waters says her party is ready to replace Labor.

"What's clear is that people are now realising that the system is stacked against them, and that the major parties don't actually want to change that system, and so they're looking for an alternative," she says.

"What they will soon come to realise is that One Nation is working for the same interests that are funding the Labor and Liberal parties."

Echoing New York mayor Zohran Mamdani in the US, Waters says Australia needs to tax the one per cent, especially gas exporters.

In housing, she criticises the government for not going far enough on proposed tax reforms, arguing that grandfathering existing negative gearing and capital gains pulls the ladder up for future generations.

Zuhria Al Hattab survived the night the sky fell on her grandmother's house in northern Gaza.

She survived the journey south — hands raised, white flag up — along a corridor the Israeli military had designated a 'safe route', until the bombs started raining again.

"The whole road was blood and martyrs and body parts, severed heads, severed hands," she tells SBS News of the aftermath of Israel's bombardment during the daytime truce.

"I was crying the whole way … but we had to keep walking continuously without stopping, not looking right or left."
